name: Vista Social
summary: Unified social media management and publishing. Schedule posts, manage conversations, and track analytics across all your brand accounts.
best_for: agencies and multi-brand teams that want scheduling, listening, reviews and reporting across many profiles at a notably lower price than legacy suites
skip_if: you manage one or two profiles (free/native tools suffice), or you need enterprise-grade approval chains and support SLAs the big suites specialize in
honest_knock: It undercuts the big suites convincingly. The honest check is coverage depth: platform APIs change constantly, so verify the specific networks and features YOUR clients need (particularly newer TikTok/threads capabilities and approval workflows) inside the trial rather than trusting the comparison table. Agencies stepping up from Professional hit the Scale tier for white-labeling — price that step into client contracts from day one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed yearly ($99 monthly), 15 profiles, 2 users
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-25 against the vendor's own pricing page; every list price rose after the 23 Sep 2026 reading) (2026) Professional $99/mo ($950/yr, shown as $80/mo on yearly billing) — 15 profiles, 2 users, 10,000 DM contacts, 1,000 AI credits/mo, Ask Vista + MCP; Advanced $199/mo ($1,910/yr, $160/mo) — 30 profiles, 4 users, 25,000 contacts, 2,000 credits, Zapier/Make integrations; Scale $449/mo ($4,310/yr, $360/mo) — 70 profiles, 8 users, 100,000 contacts, 3,500 credits, white label and client connect; Enterprise custom with unlimited profiles and users. Yearly billing is 20% off on all three priced plans. Add-ons on every tier: listening across social, web and news from $75/mo, X (Twitter) $29/mo, Employee Advocacy free for 3 advocates then from $199/mo for 25. 14-day trial, no card. Extra profiles (in increments of 10) and extra users are sold only on Scale and Enterprise; the comparison table leaves those rows empty for Professional and Advanced. Annual billing is one upfront payment for the term. Nonprofit pricing exists on Professional and Advanced for US nonprofits.
